id./param/talk_party/talk_party_a010.pack|t: It's our sixteenth birthday today... Once the ceremony's over, we'll be proper grown-ups!
With you by my side, {var:1}, I'm sure it'll all go fine. Come on, let's head for the Tor!
Monsters on the Tor, of all places! And today of all days...
I'm a bit nervous, but we've just got to be brave and keep going. I'm counting on you, {var:1}!
Thanks, {var:1}... To be honest, I thought I was done for back there. You've saved me all day long!
What was that lightning, though? Maybe Grandad knows something. Let's hurry back to everyone!
It's lovely that everyone wants to celebrate, but it's a bit embarrassing, isn't it?
Let's head to your house, {var:1}. Your mum's waiting for us!

tm.「もう お前は 立派な大人だからね。\n 困難に直面しても 自分で乗り越えていく: You're a grown man now. When trouble comes, you'll have to face it yourself. It won't be easy, but keep at it.
tm.「また すぐに出ちゃうんでしょ？\n 元気でね {var:1}。\n この村のこ: You'll be off again soon, won't you? Take care, {var:1}, and don't forget about us here!
